answer_1.quote: We introduce Lotus, a benchmark designed to explore whether LLMs can translate languages written in underrepresented scripts that they have not seen before. ... Our experiments demonstrate that, similar to unseen Latin script languages, these underrepresented script languages can also benefit from external linguistic resources, leading to improved translation performance.

answer_2.quote: Our main evaluation metric is chrF++, which is more appropriate for low-resource languages. We also report SacreBLEU scores for completeness. ... BLEU scores are also reported in the Appendix E.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation, and the results are presented in Table . Four participants who had never studied Mongolian or Yi were recruited as non-native evaluators, and two native Mongolian speakers participated as native evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: For the non-native evaluators, we provided all linguistic resources, except for the test set, along with a brief grammar guide of no more than 500 words to facilitate understanding of the target languages. Participants were allowed to use search engines but not translation software or LLMs.
